ModMetaData.name: Nelim's Pickle Tools - Interface scale
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
A Pickle step that sets the interface scale the way the Options page does, and the repair of Pickle's tag store that lets a click land at any scale but 100 percent. Development only: never published, no Defs, no features. A suite stages it with one line in a pass map. See InterfaceScale/README.md at the repository root.
It carries the same change as the pull request proposed to Pickle itself; when that lands this mod can go.
